verdict.score_rationale: The board is comfortably readable with generous corridors, clear sectioning, and mostly clean flows, but small text and the awkward elevated streaming detour keep it below fluent arm's-length reading.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Nodes and label chips have abundant surrounding air, though much of the text is small relative to the very large canvas and therefore less immediate at arm's length.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Nine clearly bounded and titled regions make membership instantly apparent, with coherent left-to-right arrangements inside each section.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: The short labeled arrows in the upper flow are clean, but the raised green 'stream tokens' route makes a long rectangular detour across a section boundary and its directional reading requires extra attention.

sub_checks.name: density_and_decomposition
sub_checks.note: Ink density is low and most sections contain only three or four well-separated nodes, leaving air as the clear majority of the board.
